name: Bento grid
description: A grid of unequal tiles, each with a small visual on top, a title and a line of text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element, which is a size container. The grid has one column, two from 36rem wide and three from 48rem.

props.name: header
props.description: The visual at the top of the tile, in a 9rem well with rounded, clipped corners. It shifts 4px when the tile is hovered.

props.name: icon
props.description: A small icon above the title.

props.name: tone
props.description: water fills the tile with the brand colour, for the one tile that should stand out.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, usually a span such as @3xl:col-span-2.
